subject: maths
question:
Simply the following expression.

7 + 35 ÷ 7 × 5 of 6 - 1
solution:
**Given:**

7 + 35 ÷ 7 × 5 of 6 - 1

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36648f6d9fd5d1d56959b630c72b514ab488f27d2525de3370bb428cc41cf8e9.png] 

**Calculation:**

7 + 35 ÷ 7 × 5 of 6 - 1

⇒ 7 + 35 ÷ 7 × 30 - 1

⇒ 7 + 5 × 30 - 1

⇒ 7 + 150 - 1

⇒ 156

**∴ Required answer is 156.**
